```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

## 1. Install packages (run once, manually)

```{r install, eval=FALSE}
install.packages(c("remotes", "dplyr", "tidyr", "ggplot2"))
remotes::install_github("statsbomb/StatsBombR")
```

## 2. Load libraries

```{r libraries}
library(StatsBombR)
library(dplyr)    # needs dplyr >= 1.1.0
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

## 3. Settings

By default this pulls **every free competition and season**, men's and women's.
The first run is slow, so each season is saved to `cache_dir` and reused on
later knits. Narrow things down here if you want a faster run.

```{r settings}
only_gender       <- NULL   # "male", "female", or NULL for both
only_competitions <- "Premier League"   # NULL = all competitions
only_seasons      <- NULL   # e.g. c("2015/2016", "2018")
refresh           <- FALSE  # TRUE = ignore the cache and re-download everything
use_parallel      <- FALSE  # TRUE can be faster, but may fail when knitting on Windows
cache_dir         <- "statsbomb_cache"
```

## 4. Competitions

```{r competitions}
competitions <- FreeCompetitions()

if (!is.null(only_gender))
  competitions <- filter(competitions, competition_gender %in% only_gender)
if (!is.null(only_competitions))
  competitions <- filter(competitions, competition_name %in% only_competitions)
if (!is.null(only_seasons))
  competitions <- filter(competitions, season_name %in% only_seasons)

competitions %>%
  select(competition_id, season_id, competition_name, season_name,
         any_of("competition_gender"))
```

## 5. Helper functions

```{r helpers}
# Add any missing columns as NA so older/newer data versions don't break us
ensure_cols <- function(df, cols) {
  miss <- setdiff(cols, names(df))
  if (length(miss)) df[miss] <- NA
  df
}

# Pull the i-th value out of a list column of c(x, y, z) vectors
get_coord <- function(lst, i) {
  vapply(lst, function(l) {
    if (length(l) >= i) as.numeric(l[[i]]) else NA_real_
  }, numeric(1))
}

# Is point (px, py) inside triangle (a, b, c)?
point_in_triangle <- function(px, py, ax, ay, bx, by, cx, cy) {
  d1 <- (px - bx) * (ay - by) - (ax - bx) * (py - by)
  d2 <- (px - cx) * (by - cy) - (bx - cx) * (py - cy)
  d3 <- (px - ax) * (cy - ay) - (cx - ax) * (py - ay)
  has_neg <- (d1 < 0) | (d2 < 0) | (d3 < 0)
  has_pos <- (d1 > 0) | (d2 > 0) | (d3 > 0)
  !(has_neg & has_pos)
}

# Features from the shot "freeze frame" (positions of players at the moment of the shot)
freeze_features <- function(ff, sx, sy) {
  out <- list(
    opponents_in_frame    = NA_integer_,  # outfield opponents visible
    teammates_in_frame    = NA_integer_,
    opps_in_shot_triangle = NA_integer_,  # outfield opponents between shot and both posts
    opps_within_3m        = NA_integer_,
    nearest_opp_dist      = NA_real_,
    gk_x                  = NA_real_,
    gk_y                  = NA_real_,
    gk_dist_to_goal       = NA_real_
  )
  if (!is.data.frame(ff) || nrow(ff) == 0 || is.na(sx) || is.na(sy))
    return(as_tibble(out))

  loc <- ff$location
  if (is.list(loc)) loc <- do.call(rbind, lapply(loc, function(l) as.numeric(l)[1:2]))
  if (is.data.frame(loc)) loc <- as.matrix(loc)
  if (is.null(loc) || nrow(loc) == 0) return(as_tibble(out))

  px <- loc[, 1]; py <- loc[, 2]
  tm  <- if ("teammate" %in% names(ff)) ff$teammate %in% TRUE else rep(FALSE, nrow(ff))
  pos <- if ("position.name" %in% names(ff)) ff$position.name else rep(NA_character_, nrow(ff))

  gk       <- !tm & (pos %in% "Goalkeeper")
  opp_out  <- !tm & !gk
  d        <- sqrt((px - sx)^2 + (py - sy)^2)
  in_tri   <- point_in_triangle(px, py, sx, sy, 120, 36, 120, 44)

  out$opponents_in_frame    <- sum(opp_out)
  out$teammates_in_frame    <- sum(tm)
  out$opps_in_shot_triangle <- sum(opp_out & in_tri)
  out$opps_within_3m        <- sum(opp_out & d <= 3)
  out$nearest_opp_dist      <- if (any(opp_out)) min(d[opp_out]) else NA_real_
  if (any(gk)) {
    out$gk_x <- px[gk][1]
    out$gk_y <- py[gk][1]
    out$gk_dist_to_goal <- sqrt((120 - out$gk_x)^2 + (40 - out$gk_y)^2)
  }
  as_tibble(out)
}
```

## 6. Function that processes one competition-season

For each season it downloads all events, then keeps shots plus the pass that
created each shot (the "key pass"), and adds extra features.

```{r process}
shot_cols <- c(
  "id", "index", "match_id", "team.name", "player.name", "player.id",
  "position.name", "minute", "second", "period", "possession",
  "possession_team.name", "play_pattern.name", "under_pressure",
  "location", "location.x", "location.y",
  "shot.statsbomb_xg", "shot.outcome.name", "shot.body_part.name",
  "shot.type.name", "shot.technique.name", "shot.first_time",
  "shot.one_on_one", "shot.aerial_won", "shot.follows_dribble",
  "shot.redirect", "shot.deflected", "shot.open_goal",
  "shot.key_pass_id", "shot.end_location", "shot.freeze_frame"
)

pass_cols <- c(
  "id", "player.name", "position.name", "location", "pass.end_location",
  "pass.length", "pass.angle", "pass.height.name", "pass.body_part.name",
  "pass.type.name", "pass.technique.name", "pass.cross", "pass.through_ball",
  "pass.cut_back", "pass.switch", "pass.goal_assist"
)

match_cols <- c(
  "match_id", "match_date", "kick_off", "match_week",
  "competition.competition_name", "competition.country_name",
  "season.season_name", "competition_stage.name", "stadium.name",
  "referee.name", "home_team.home_team_name", "away_team.away_team_name",
  "home_score", "away_score"
)

process_season <- function(comp_row) {

  matches <- FreeMatches(comp_row)
  events  <- free_allevents(MatchesDF = matches, Parallel = use_parallel)
  events  <- allclean(events)

  # ---- Shots ----
  sh <- events %>%
    filter(type.name == "Shot") %>%
    ensure_cols(shot_cols)
  if (nrow(sh) == 0) return(NULL)

  sh$sx <- if ("location.x" %in% names(sh) && !all(is.na(sh$location.x)))
    as.numeric(sh$location.x) else get_coord(sh$location, 1)
  sh$sy <- if ("location.y" %in% names(sh) && !all(is.na(sh$location.y)))
    as.numeric(sh$location.y) else get_coord(sh$location, 2)

  freeze <- bind_rows(Map(freeze_features, sh$shot.freeze_frame, sh$sx, sh$sy))

  shots <- sh %>%
    transmute(
      event_id        = id,
      event_index     = index,
      match_id,
      team            = team.name,
      player          = player.name,
      player_id       = player.id,
      position        = position.name,
      period, minute, second,
      time            = minute + second / 60,
      possession,
      possession_team = possession_team.name,
      play_pattern    = play_pattern.name,
      under_pressure  = under_pressure %in% TRUE,
      x = sx, y = sy,
      distance_to_goal = sqrt((120 - sx)^2 + (40 - sy)^2),
      angle_to_goal    = abs(atan2(44 - sy, 120 - sx) - atan2(36 - sy, 120 - sx)),
      end_x = get_coord(shot.end_location, 1),
      end_y = get_coord(shot.end_location, 2),
      end_z = get_coord(shot.end_location, 3),
      xg              = as.numeric(shot.statsbomb_xg),
      outcome         = shot.outcome.name,
      is_goal         = shot.outcome.name %in% "Goal",
      on_target       = tolower(shot.outcome.name) %in% c("goal", "saved", "saved to post"),
      body_part       = shot.body_part.name,
      shot_type       = shot.type.name,
      technique       = shot.technique.name,
      is_penalty      = shot.type.name %in% "Penalty",
      is_header       = shot.body_part.name %in% "Head",
      first_time      = shot.first_time %in% TRUE,
      one_on_one      = shot.one_on_one %in% TRUE,
      aerial_won      = shot.aerial_won %in% TRUE,
      follows_dribble = shot.follows_dribble %in% TRUE,
      redirect        = shot.redirect %in% TRUE,
      deflected       = shot.deflected %in% TRUE,
      open_goal       = shot.open_goal %in% TRUE,
      key_pass_id     = as.character(shot.key_pass_id)
    ) %>%
    bind_cols(freeze)

  # ---- The pass that created each shot ----
  kp_ids <- unique(na.omit(shots$key_pass_id))
  assists <- events %>%
    filter(id %in% kp_ids) %>%
    ensure_cols(pass_cols) %>%
    transmute(
      key_pass_id     = as.character(id),
      assist_player   = player.name,
      assist_position = position.name,
      assist_start_x  = get_coord(location, 1),
      assist_start_y  = get_coord(location, 2),
      assist_end_x    = get_coord(pass.end_location, 1),
      assist_end_y    = get_coord(pass.end_location, 2),
      assist_length   = as.numeric(pass.length),
      assist_angle    = as.numeric(pass.angle),
      assist_height   = pass.height.name,
      assist_body_part = pass.body_part.name,
      assist_type     = pass.type.name,       # Corner, Free Kick, Throw-in, ...
      assist_technique = pass.technique.name,
      assist_cross    = pass.cross %in% TRUE,
      assist_through_ball = pass.through_ball %in% TRUE,
      assist_cut_back = pass.cut_back %in% TRUE,
      assist_switch   = pass.switch %in% TRUE,
      is_goal_assist  = pass.goal_assist %in% TRUE
    ) %>%
    distinct(key_pass_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

  shots <- left_join(shots, assists, by = "key_pass_id")

  # ---- Score at the moment of the shot ----
  goals <- events %>%
    filter(period < 5,
           (type.name %in% "Shot" & shot.outcome.name %in% "Goal") |
             type.name %in% "Own Goal For") %>%
    select(match_id, goal_team = team.name, goal_index = index)

  game_state <- shots %>%
    select(event_id, match_id, team, event_index) %>%
    left_join(goals, by = "match_id", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    group_by(event_id) %>%
    summarise(
      team_goals_before = sum(goal_team == team & goal_index < event_index, na.rm = TRUE),
      opp_goals_before  = sum(goal_team != team & goal_index < event_index, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  shots <- shots %>%
    left_join(game_state, by = "event_id") %>%
    mutate(
      score_diff = team_goals_before - opp_goals_before,
      game_state = case_when(score_diff > 0 ~ "Leading",
                             score_diff < 0 ~ "Trailing",
                             TRUE ~ "Level"),
      is_shootout = period == 5
    )

  # ---- Match / competition info ----
  mi <- matches %>%
    ensure_cols(match_cols) %>%
    transmute(
      match_id, match_date, kick_off, match_week,
      competition = competition.competition_name,
      country     = competition.country_name,
      season      = season.season_name,
      stage       = competition_stage.name,
      stadium     = stadium.name,
      referee     = referee.name,
      home_team   = home_team.home_team_name,
      away_team   = away_team.away_team_name,
      home_score, away_score
    ) %>%
    mutate(competition_gender = if ("competition_gender" %in% names(comp_row))
      as.character(comp_row$competition_gender) else NA_character_)

  shots %>%
    left_join(mi, by = "match_id") %>%
    mutate(
      is_home  = team == home_team,
      opponent = if_else(is_home, away_team, home_team)
    ) %>%
    relocate(competition, competition_gender, season, stage, match_id,
             match_date, home_team, away_team, team, opponent, is_home)
}
```

## 7. Download everything

Run this chunk interactively the first time and expect a long wait (it is a lot
of data). Finished seasons are cached in `cache_dir`, so re-running or knitting
afterwards is fast and resumes where it left off.

```{r download}
dir.create(cache_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
results  <- vector("list", nrow(competitions))
failures <- character()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(competitions))) {
  comp  <- competitions[i, ]
  label <- paste(comp$competition_name, comp$season_name)
  f <- file.path(cache_dir,
                 sprintf("shots_%s_%s.rds", comp$competition_id, comp$season_id))

  if (file.exists(f) && !refresh) {
    results[[i]] <- readRDS(f)
    next
  }

  message(sprintf("[%d/%d] %s", i, nrow(competitions), label))
  res <- tryCatch(process_season(comp), error = function(e) {
    message("  FAILED: ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  })

  if (is.null(res)) {
    failures <- c(failures, label)
  } else {
    saveRDS(res, f)
    results[[i]] <- res
  }
}

shots <- bind_rows(results)

cat("Shots:", nrow(shots), "| Matches:", n_distinct(shots$match_id),
    "| Competition-seasons failed/empty:", length(failures), "\n")
if (length(failures)) print(failures)
```

## 8. What's in the data

Beyond the raw StatsBomb fields, these features are added:

| Group | Columns |
|---|---|
| Shot basics | `x`, `y`, `end_x`, `end_y`, `end_z` (shot height), `xg`, `outcome`, `is_goal`, `on_target`, `body_part`, `shot_type`, `technique`, `play_pattern`, `position` |
| Geometry | `distance_to_goal`, `angle_to_goal` (radians, angle the goal subtends) |
| Flags | `is_penalty`, `is_header`, `first_time`, `one_on_one`, `open_goal`, `aerial_won`, `follows_dribble`, `redirect`, `deflected`, `under_pressure` |
| Defensive picture (freeze frame) | `opps_in_shot_triangle`, `opps_within_3m`, `nearest_opp_dist`, `opponents_in_frame`, `teammates_in_frame`, `gk_x`, `gk_y`, `gk_dist_to_goal` |
| Creating pass | `assist_player`, `assist_type`, `assist_height`, `assist_length`, `assist_cross`, `assist_through_ball`, `assist_cut_back`, `is_goal_assist`, and start/end coordinates |
| Game context | `team_goals_before`, `opp_goals_before`, `score_diff`, `game_state`, `time`, `period`, `is_shootout` |
| Match context | `competition`, `competition_gender`, `country`, `season`, `stage`, `stadium`, `referee`, `home_team`, `away_team`, `is_home`, `opponent`, `match_date`, `kick_off`, `home_score`, `away_score` |

Pitch coordinates are on a 120 x 80 pitch, with the attacking goal at x = 120.
Shots from penalty shootouts are flagged by `is_shootout`.

```{r glimpse}
glimpse(shots)
```

## 9. Summaries

Shots, goals and xG by competition and season (shootouts excluded):

```{r by-competition}
shots %>%
  filter(!is_shootout) %>%
  group_by(competition, season) %>%
  summarise(
    matches = n_distinct(match_id),
    shots   = n(),
    goals   = sum(is_goal),
    xg      = round(sum(xg, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    goals_minus_xg = round(goals - xg, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(shots))
```

Top players by non-penalty xG (at least 50 shots):

```{r top-players}
shots %>%
  filter(!is_shootout, !is_penalty) %>%
  group_by(player) %>%
  summarise(
    shots = n(),
    goals = sum(is_goal),
    npxg  = round(sum(xg, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    npxg_per_shot = round(npxg / shots, 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(shots >= 50) %>%
  arrange(desc(npxg)) %>%
  head(20)
```

Team xG per match:

```{r team-match}
shot_summary <- shots %>%
  filter(!is_shootout) %>%
  group_by(competition, season, match_id, match_date, team, opponent) %>%
  summarise(
    shots    = n(),
    on_target = sum(on_target),
    goals    = sum(is_goal),
    xg       = round(sum(xg, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )
head(shot_summary, 10)
```

## 10. Plots

Average xG by distance to goal:

```{r xg-distance, fig.width=8, fig.height=4.5}
shots %>%
  filter(!is_shootout, !is_penalty, !is.na(xg)) %>%
  mutate(dist_bin = cut(distance_to_goal, breaks = seq(0, 50, 2.5), include.lowest = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(dist_bin)) %>%
  group_by(dist_bin) %>%
  summarise(mean_xg = mean(xg), goal_rate = mean(is_goal), n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(dist_bin)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = mean_xg), fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(y = goal_rate), colour = "red", size = 2) +
  labs(x = "Distance to goal (yards)", y = "Mean xG (bars) / actual goal rate (dots)",
       title = "xG vs distance") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

Where shots come from (all competitions, open play, non-penalty):

```{r shot-density, fig.width=8, fig.height=5.5}
shots %>%
  filter(!is_shootout, !is_penalty, !is.na(x), !is.na(y), x >= 60) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x, y)) +
  geom_bin2d(binwidth = c(2, 2)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", trans = "sqrt", name = "Shots") +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 102, xmax = 120, ymin = 18, ymax = 62, fill = NA, colour = "white") +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 114, xmax = 120, ymin = 30, ymax = 50, fill = NA, colour = "white") +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(60, 120), ylim = c(0, 80)) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(title = "Shot locations", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 11. Save

```{r save}
write.csv(shots, "statsbomb_shots_all.csv", row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(shots, "statsbomb_shots_all.rds")
```
